title: Tamp the coffee in a portafilter level with a tamper, then lock the portafilter into an espresso machine's group head
instruction: Tamp the ground coffee in the portafilter level with the tamper, then lock the portafilter into the espresso machine's group head, ready to brew, and let go of it.
context: Tamping and locking in the portafilter is the core step of making an espresso, at home or behind a counter: the coffee must be pressed by the tamper, square into a level basket, before the portafilter goes into the machine. Resting on the counter on its spout and handle, the basket is tipped.
setup: A table (the counter) in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them; angles about the vertical are counterclockwise seen from above, from straight ahead. (1) A fixed espresso machine: a black body 11 x 20 cm and 23 cm tall, 46.5 to 57.5 cm forward and centred 10 cm left of the centre line, with a chrome group head facing down whose axis is 36 cm forward, 10 cm left. The head's two lips, 3 mm thick and reaching 4 to 5 cm from its axis, have their underside 11 cm above the counter and span 30 to 68 and 210 to 248 degrees; elsewhere the head is open. 14 mm above the lips' underside is the head's ceiling, with a stepped boss under it (5.8 cm across, 1.1 cm deep). A black drip tray 9 x 15 cm and 2 cm tall stands under the head. (2) A loose portafilter, 80 g: a steel basket 7 cm across and 2.5 cm deep, a chrome spout block 1.4 x 2.4 cm and 2.2 cm tall under it, a black handle 15 cm long, 2 cm wide and 2.2 cm tall from the basket's side, and two chrome ears 1.2 cm long on the rim, one each side, square to the handle. Its basket's axis is 26 cm forward, 4 cm left, its handle pointing left; it rests on its spout and its handle's end, tipped 7.9 degrees. Ground coffee fills the basket level with its rim. (3) A loose tamper, 150 g: a steel base 5.6 cm across and 1.2 cm tall, a wooden neck 1.8 cm across and 5 cm tall and a wooden knob, standing on the counter 30 cm forward, 15 cm right. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. Tamped: the coffee pressed at least 6 mm below the rim by the tamper: only pressing done while the tamper's base is on the coffee (its centre within 7 mm of the basket's axis, its underside within 4 mm of the coffee's surface or into it) and before the portafilter has gone into the group head (its basket's axis within 3 cm of the head's) counts; the coffee pressed by anything else (a gripper, the head's boss) earns nothing. Level: whenever the coffee was being pressed down, the basket was within 5 degrees of level, and while the tamper pressed it, the tamper's axis was within 5 degrees of the basket's (a flat, level tamp). In a real trial both are checked from the side camera, and the tamped bed is checked flat and 6 mm or more below the rim before the portafilter is locked in. Locked: the basket's axis within 6 mm of the group head's axis and within 8 degrees of vertical, its rim 3 to 15 mm above the lips' underside, and the handle turned 35 to 60 degrees from pointing left (the ears resting over the lips). Let go: both grippers' fingertip centres (TCPs) at least 4 cm from the portafilter's handle and basket. 1.0: tamped, level, locked and both let go; 0.5: tamped and level; 0.25: tamped; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with the portafilter still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Lift the coffee back level with the rim (or refill the basket), take the portafilter out of the head and rest it on the counter as in the screenshot, and stand the tamper back.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the ground coffee is one disc on a slider down the basket's axis that stays where it is pressed (springing back 1 mm), with no grains, so a pressed bed is level by construction and the tamp is judged from the tamper's pose; the portafilter is light (80 g); the group head is polished (low friction); no water or pressure. The machine is fixed. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
